name: Flat geometric isometric
summary: Clean geometric architecture in an orthographic isometric view, coloured in flat pastel faces with no texture. Stairs, arches and towers are built like a paper model, and the space can fold into impossible shapes.

philosophy.core_thesis: Architecture reduced to pure faces and an orthographic view becomes a calm puzzle that a hand can turn.
design_principles: Use an orthographic isometric camera with no perspective.
Colour each face direction in its own flat pastel tone: top light, sides darker.
Build with cubes, arches, stairs and columns only; no texture.
Keep generous empty space around the structure.
Use a soft gradient sky in one hue as the ground.
Make the figure tiny and simple against the structure.

projection_and_camera.camera: Fixed orthographic; the player rotates the structure, not the camera.
projection_and_camera.framing: One structure centred in a portrait or a landscape frame with wide margins.

geometry.primitive: Clean low-poly cubes, arches and stairs.
geometry.budget: A few thousand triangles for a whole level.
geometry.edge_rule: Crisp edges with no outlines; faces separate by tone.
geometry.proportion: A figure is 1/10 to 1/20 of the structure height.

surface.texture_rule: No texture; flat colour per face.
surface.filtering: Not used: faces have no texture.
surface.material_model: Unlit or a fixed 3-tone face shade.

palette.strategy: Pastel, harmonious hues; one palette for each level, a gradient sky.

lighting.model: Fixed tones per face direction; no dynamic light.
lighting.shadows: None, or flat shapes in a darker tone.
lighting.atmosphere: A soft gradient sky; a few floating particles.
lighting.time_of_day: A palette per level: dawn pinks, night blues.

world_and_space.scale: Monumental: the figure is tiny against towers and stairs.
world_and_space.interiors: Courtyards and rooms open to the sky, cut away like a model.
world_and_space.exteriors: A single tower or a floating island of stairs and arches.
world_and_space.threshold: A door is a dark rectangle; the figure walks in and out with no cut.

principles.rule: Make the figure 1/10 to 1/20 of the structure height.
Mark the goal with the one saturated tone in the scene.
Align paths so the camera sees each step; hide nothing behind a wall.

interface.placement: Almost none; a small pause icon in a corner.
interface.type_and_icons: Thin geometric sans and simple line icons.
interface.diegesis: Nearly all in the world: levers and paths are part of the structure.

emotion.target_response: Serene wonder: the viewer feels calm, curious and a little dreamy.

avoid_when: The brief needs real materials or textures.

modifiers.how: Keep the angle; redraw in pixel art with 3-tone faces.
Add depth of field, light and texture as in a miniature.

texel_density.note: No texture: the floor of the range.
